name: A rejected usage import explains itself

planSteps.description: Open the app and wait for the initial solve.
In 'Your own usage', clear the textarea and paste: first line 'timestamp,kwh', second line '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z,1.0'.
Verify an error message appears instead of a bill, and that it mentions the timestamp or alignment so a user can tell what to fix.
Clear the textarea, paste just the word 'garbage', and click 'Bill this usage' again.
Verify a second, different error appears naming the line or the value that could not be read.
